name: InterContinental Beijing Sanlitun
positioning: Modern luxury hotel in Beijing's Sanlitun entertainment and fashion district, next to the embassy area and the Central Business District
best_for: Travelers who want a stylish base in Sanlitun
Business travelers visiting the embassy area or the Central Business District

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Sanlitun, Beijing's entertainment and fashion district.
The hotel is next to the embassy area and the Central Business District.
Club InterContinental is on the 22nd floor, with floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and views over Sanlitun.
Rooms and suites have a contemporary design, and many have expansive windows with views.
Suites include the Terrace Suite, the Ambassador Suite and the Presidential Suite.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool with a whirlpool.
The fitness center has an onsite sports trainer, and loaner bikes are available.
CHAR serves premium steaks and wines with Sanlitun views in an open-kitchen setting.
Ying Yan is the hotel's Cantonese restaurant, with open kitchens.
The Forbidden City is about 6.2 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: Club InterContinental sits on the 22nd floor, with floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows looking over Sanlitun.

With Liangma River International Waterfront, the hotel offers a riverside cruise exclusively for guests, and the concierge team curates waterside itineraries for occasions such as birthdays and anniversaries.

considerations.text: The indoor pool is part of Wellness Oasis, which is managed by a third party.
WhataHotel notes the bustling Sanlitun neighborhood can feel lively and fast-paced for guests seeking a quieter retreat.
